book.name: Lom
book.title: LOM Pol Lom Binɨb Kɨlop Mɨj Tɨkak

content: Mubwak gos tɨmud chɨn ak, God nop tap sɨbog ñeb tek ñɨnɨgun

Anɨb ak mam ay sɨkop, yad God chɨnop mapen nɨgup agɨl, nɨbop kɨles gɨl agnɨŋɨd anɨb agebin. Mubwak gos tɨmud nɨbi ak dɨl, God nop pel tap sɨbog ñeb tek ñɨnɨmɨb. Nɨbi God yɨl mɨdɨl ne agak tek nep kɨdek gɨl, tap anɨb anɨb gon nop tep gup agɨl gɨnɨmɨb. Pelpel anɨgɨpɨm ak, God nop kɨgom yɨmɨl nɨŋɨd yɨbɨl agnepɨm.

Binɨb lum awl pel gɨpal tek ma gɨnɨmɨb. Nɨbi pen God yɨl mɨdem, nɨbop gos kɨdeyɨl ñaknɨŋ, binɨb gos ke kɨdeyɨl nɨb tek lɨnɨmɨb. Nɨbop gos ñɨl, ke kɨdeyɨl nɨb tek lek gem amek nɨm, God gos ne ke nɨgup ak nɨgɨnɨgabɨm. Gos ne ke nɨgup ak mɨdupsek, mɨdtep gɨnɨgab adek ak sek, nop tep gɨnɨgab adek ak sek, yɨpɨd gɨl yɨbɨl gɨnɨgab adek ak sek, gos ne ke nɨgup ak mɨdupsek nɨgtep gɨnɨgabɨm.
God chɨnop kɨles teplep keke ñek, wog ne gɨtep gɨnɨgun

God ne yɨp yɨmug nɨŋɨd gɨtep gek, yad nɨbop keke mɨdupsek anɨgɨl agebin. Nɨbi chɨn yɨb awl dɨl, yɨb chɨn adek alaŋ yek binɨb ogɨnap yɨb kɨli ayaŋ mɨdeb agɨl ma nɨgɨnɨmɨb. Pen gos nɨgtep gɨl, God nɨbop gek nop gos lɨnepɨm ak nɨgɨnɨmɨb. Nɨŋɨd, tap nɨbi ke gɨpɨm ak sek gos nepɨm ak sek tɨg asɨkɨnɨmɨb.
Chɨn nopun, chɨn keke mubwak nokom olap, mubwak ak ñɨn kɨd tob kɨd day keke mɨdeb. Pen day keke mɨdeb tek, wog keke yɨbɨl gɨpal.

Chɨn Klays yɨl mɨdobun okok abe, anɨb ak tek mɨdobun. Binɨb keke kuŋay mɨdobun ak pen, Klays yɨl mɨdɨl mubwak nokom mɨdobun. Pen ñɨn kɨd tob kɨd day keke mubwak nokom mɨdeb tek, chɨn ke penpen don mubwak nokom mɨdobun.
God chɨnop yɨmug nɨŋɨd gɨtep gɨl, kɨles teplep keke ñub. God binɨb olap nop kɨles ñek, bɨ God gos ñek agñeb tek lup. Lek, ne Klays nop gos lɨnɨŋɨd, bɨ God gos ñek agñeb takaw ak agñɨnɨmuŋ.
Binɨb olap nop kɨles ñek, tap malɨk gɨl gɨñeb tek lek, malɨk gɨl gɨñɨnɨmuŋ. Binɨb olap nop kɨles ñek, binɨb kɨlop God takaw ak agñɨtep gep tek lek, takaw agñɨtep gɨnɨmuŋ.

Binɨb olap nop kɨles ñek, takaw tep ak agñek binɨb gos sek mɨdep tek lup. Lek, binɨb kɨlop gos sek yenɨgel agɨl takaw tep ak agñɨnɨmuŋ. Binɨb olap nop kɨles ñek, binɨb kɨlop tap ñeb tek lek, tap kuŋay yɨbɨl monmon ñɨnɨmuŋ. Binɨb olap nop kɨles ñek, wog ak binɨb kɨlop kod mɨdep tek lup. Lek, nɨgtep gɨl wog anɨb ak kod mɨdtep gɨnɨmuŋ. Binɨb olap nop kɨles ñek, binɨb kɨlop mapen nɨŋɨd dɨtep gep tek lek, mɨñmɨñ gɨlɨg kɨlop mapen nɨŋɨd dɨtep gɨnɨmuŋ.
Chɨn binɨb ogɨnap kɨlop gɨtep gɨnɨgun
Binɨb okok kɨlop mapen lɨpɨm ak, yepɨs ma gɨnɨmɨb. Tap tɨmel gep ak kud ñɨl pɨsnep kelɨgɨl, tap tep gep ak chɨg tep gɨnɨmɨb.
Mam ay Klays yɨl mɨdebal okok kɨli mam ay mapen yad mɨdebal agɨl, ayɨp penpen mapen lɨnɨmɨb. Nɨbi pelpel mam ay Klays yɨl mɨdebal okok yɨb kɨlop ak dad aplanɨmɨb.
Yɨlɨk yɨlɨk sek wog ma gɨnɨmɨb. Tep gaknɨŋ, Bɨawl ak nop wog gobun agɨl, gɨtep gɨnɨmɨb.
Gos sek kod mɨdɨlɨg, mɨñmɨñ gɨnɨmɨb. Nɨbop gɨ tɨmel gel mɨŋel dɨpɨm ak, mɨŋel okok dɨl kɨles gɨl jak yenɨmɨb. Mɨnek mɨnek God ayɨp agɨnɨmɨb.
Binɨb Klays yɨl mɨdel tap ma mɨdeb okok, tap nɨbi ogɨnap kɨlop ñɨl gɨñɨnɨmɨb. Binɨb okok nɨb okok nɨb ownɨgel ak, kɨlop ag dap kal mɨgan nɨbi lɨnɨmɨb.
Binɨb nɨbop gɨ tɨmel gɨpal ak, God nop agnɨgem, kɨlop gɨtep gɨnɨmuŋ. Yaw, God nop agnɨgem, kɨlop gɨtep gɨnɨmuŋ. Kɨlop pen mɨlɨk nɨŋɨd, God kɨlop gɨ tɨmel gɨnɨmuŋ agɨl, nop anɨb ak ma agnɨgɨnɨmɨb.
Binɨb mɨñmɨñ gɨl mɨdebal ak, kɨli ayɨp mɨñmɨñ gɨl yenɨmɨb. Binɨb chɨb gaknɨŋ chaŋ lɨl mɨdebal ak, kɨli ayɨp chɨb gaknɨŋ chaŋ lɨl yenɨmɨb.

Nɨbi gos pal nokom olap nɨŋɨd, binbɨ okok mɨdupsek gɨnɨmɨb. Chɨn binɨb yɨb sek mɨdobun agɨl ma nɨŋɨd, yɨb nɨbi ma dad aplanɨmɨb. Binɨb yɨb ma mɨdeb okok ayɨp wɨlɨkɨl yenɨmɨb. Chɨn nep bɨ gos nɨgep nɨgtep gɨpun agɨl ma nɨgɨnɨmɨb.
Binɨb nɨbop mɨlɨk nɨŋɨd gɨ tɨmel gɨpal ak, pen mɨlɨk nɨŋɨd gɨ tɨmel ma gɨnɨmɨb. Binɨb okok mɨdupsek chɨn gɨpun ak nɨgel kɨlop tep gɨnɨgab agɨl, adek anɨb ak nep gɨnɨmɨb.

Nɨbi binɨb ayɨp penpen gɨnɨgun agɨl gos ak ma nɨgɨnɨmɨb, kɨmɨgel jɨmñɨl yonɨgun agɨl gos anep nɨgɨnɨmɨb. Binɨb ogɨnap kɨli kɨmɨgel jɨmñɨl yonɨgun agɨl gos ma nepal ak pen, nɨbi kɨles gɨl kɨmɨgel jɨmñɨl yenɨmɨb.

Binɨb mapen yad okok, binɨb nɨbop gɨ tɨmel gɨpal ak, kɨlop pen gɨ tɨmel gɨnɨgun agɨl gos ak ma nɨgɨnɨmɨb. Ak God gos ne. Kɨlop pen gɨ tɨmel gin agɨl, ke nɨgup tek gɨnɨgab. Nɨb nepɨm, Bɨawl ak ne takaw agak anɨb ak, buk Baybol ak tɨkɨl agak,

content.text: Binɨb gɨ tɨmel gɨpal okok, yad nokom kɨlop pen gɨ tɨmel gɨl yɨpɨl awl ñɨnɨgayn agɨl tɨkak. Wog anɨb ak yad pel anɨgɨpin agɨl tɨkak.

content: Nɨbi pen buk Baybol agak ak kɨdek gɨnɨmɨb. Tɨkɨl anɨb agak,

content.text: Nad bɨ nep mɨlɨk nɨgup ak amɨl, nop yuwan gonɨmuŋ tap mɨdup ñɨnɨmɨn agɨl tɨkak. Kuŋam mɨlep gonɨmuŋ ñɨg ak ñɨnɨmɨn agɨl tɨkak. Anɨge nɨŋɨd, nep taynen gɨ tɨmel gɨpin agɨl, gos kuŋay nɨgek nop nebeŋ dɨnɨgab agɨl tɨkak.

content: Nɨbi kelɨgem, tap tɨmel okok nɨbop ma kodɨnɨmuŋ. Nɨbi pen gɨtep gem, gɨtep gɨpɨm anɨb ak tap tɨmel ak taw jɨsɨpuk gɨl yu gɨnɨmuŋ.
